identity.headline: PhD in breaking things apart until I understand how they work.
intro: Curiosity brought me into technology. AI became how I build.
I keep pulling systems apart until I understand enough to build with them.

story.heading: I wanted to understand how machines are built.
paragraphs: When ChatGPT 3.5 arrived, technology became something I could question, provoke, and take apart.
I learned by experimenting, pushing limits, breaking assumptions, and tracing what happened next.
That loop turned curiosity into a direction.

story.heading: Frontend became my entry into software.
paragraphs: I started a 400 YH-point Front End Developer program and gained a structured view of JavaScript, APIs, testing, UX, accessibility, agile work, and delivery.

story.heading: Using AI became AI-first development.
paragraphs: I moved from prompting tools to building systems through them.
My work expanded into agent orchestration, custom harnesses, AI memory, token optimization, and specialized AI-native SaaS products.
I also began running open-weight models in Google Colab with access to approximately 40 GB of VRAM and contributing to open-source projects.

story.heading: I am following the systems underneath the tools.
paragraphs: My current focus is graph engineering, context engineering, and machine-learning foundations.

howIBuild.intro: AI is not an add-on to my workflow. It is the environment I build through.
